changelog:
Initial release: Quick-start guidance for building clinical and healthcare apps in Lovable, tailored for OpenClaw Clinical Hackathon participants.

- Provides step-by-step instructions for setting up clinical projects in Lovable, including planning, building components, and best practices for PHI safety.
- Highlights common clinical app patterns (intake, dashboard, assessments) and advises on MVP scope.
- Emphasizes using Plan mode first, then Agent mode per component, and how to handle auth and data securely.
- Includes contextual information about OpenClaw and ClawHub, with pointers for integrating chat workflows.
- Offers practical examples and guidance specifically for hackathon use cases.
summary: Helps OpenClaw Clinical Hackathon participants get started quickly building clinical and healthcare apps with Lovable. Use when the user is building a clinic...
